title: BetaClaudeTagSlackWorkspace
description: A Slack workspace the organization has connected, itself or through its Slack Enterprise Grid, with the settings it stores or, with `include_inherited`, the settings that apply in it.

id.description: The workspace's identifier. Starts with `slws_`. It does not change for as long as the workspace is set up. A workspace that is removed and set up again has a new one, and the old one keeps returning 404; look the workspace up by its Slack identifier for the new one.

slack.description: Slack's own identifier for the workspace.

settings.description: What the workspace itself stores or, with `include_inherited`, what applies in it. `sources` says which.

sources.description: For each setting, the settings level its value in `settings` comes from.

created_at.description: Time the workspace was set up, by whichever route. It does not change for as long as `id` does not.

updated_at.description: Time Claude Tag's record of the workspace last changed. It moves on every change to a setting, and can also move when something no response holds changes, so a later value says to read the workspace again, not that a setting changed. Attaching or detaching a Bundle does not by itself move it.
